newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour maintains 18-point lead in Harris poll.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour maintains 18-point lead in Harris poll.

text.p: Britain's main opposition Labour Party maintained its 18-point lead in a Harris poll, the Independent newspaper said on Thursday.
The poll showed Labour on 48 percent, the Conservatives on 30, the Liberal Democrats on 15 and others on seven percent.
The last survey by Harris for the newspaper on April 18 had Labour on 49 percent, the Conservatives on 31, the Liberal Democrats on 13 and others on six.

In a statement the newspaper said 80 percent of those who said they would vote for Labour were "certain to vote Labour" but only 60 percent of Conservatives said they were certain to vote Conservative.
Twice as many Conservative voters as Labour voters said there was a chance they could change their minds before election day on May 1.
Harris interviewed 1,177 adults between April 18 and 21.
